title: Creative Problem Solving and Decision Making
overview: Throughout this course, we will address these essential thinking approaches. Following a comprehensive understanding of these cognitive processes, we will equip you with practical methods and tools. These will be actively practiced during the sessions, proving valuable not only in professional settings but also in various aspects of life—ranging from routine scenarios to challenging or unconventional situations.
audience: Managers, supervisors, and administrators seeking to enhance their problem-solving and decision-making skills will find this course valuable. Additionally, business professionals aiming to elevate their critical thinking to a higher level by integrating both experience and intuition into their decision-making process will also benefit
methodology: The course employs a diverse range of interactive techniques, including concise presentations by both the consultant and participants, role plays (both rehearsed and impromptu), video clips with thorough debriefs, and individual as well as group feedback
competencies: Problem-Solving Ability and Anticipating Potential Problems
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop and enhance decision-making, critical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills
Apply logical and creative methodologies to problem-solving and decision-making processes
Utilize both traditional and creative tools for identifying causes and generating solutions
Incorporate creativity and lateral thinking as effective business tools
Analyze and resolve real-world problems encountered in the workplace
Demonstrate and cultivate credibility with upper management
Formulate strategic approaches to problem-solving and decision-making
